flakes.symptom: Session browser project: "Failed to import test file .../<name>.test.tsx" caused by "TypeError: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module: http://localhost:<port>/...test.tsx?import"; the file runs 0 tests and a later file reports "Failed to run the test". Hit input-area-mention-escape, input-area-slash-draft and others, never a fixed file.
flakes.evidence: CI runs https://github.com/GUYI-AI/gugu/actions/runs/41903402541 and https://github.com/GUYI-AI/gugu/actions/runs/41997775721, on PRs whose diffs do not reach the failing files. Not optimizeDeps: the browser server logs no dependency re-optimization or reload in either run. The import fetch fails under 0.4 s after start. Chromium refuses fetches past a per-renderer outstanding-request limit (net::ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES), and one composer-graph import issues about 1,700 requests; what exhausts the budget is not yet found. Reproduced once locally under heavy concurrent load; 16 later full runs green.

flakes.symptom: Unit tests: "Cannot find module .../@visactor/vchart/esm/util/id", reported in whichever test was running when the lazy chart import settled.
flakes.note: The bare-name vi.mock('@visactor/react-vchart') registered an id the product import never hits (the package is installed only under apps/desktop), so the real chart loaded under Node ESM, which rejects vchart's extensionless imports. Fixed by mocking the apps/desktop path, as CreditChartsV2.test.ts does; filePreviewZoom's pdfjs mock had the same miss. First CI sighting: https://github.com/GUYI-AI/gugu/actions/runs/41955271605

flakes.test: tests/unit/scripts/devNodeExternals.test.ts > Electron development dependency externalization > externalizes installed CommonJS packages, bundles ESM and local source, and rebuilds changes
flakes.symptom: macOS tooling job: the case runs to the 60 s cap and never sees the rebuild.
flakes.note: Rollup emits END as soon as it starts watching, before FSEvents has subscribed; an edit made in that window is never reported. The test now keeps the edit applied until the watcher reports it. mac 8 parallel x 6 rounds: parent 7/48 hung, fix 0/48. First CI sighting: https://github.com/GUYI-AI/gugu/actions/runs/41945123872

flakes.symptom: Case "B-life-first: record each actual paint boundary before Q starts" hangs to the 60 s cap with "[awaiting-fact] the same queued identity has the saved text — last observed: false".
flakes.note: The test typed as soon as the outbox row carried the edit reservation, before the composer re-rendered in edit mode, so the text went to the normal draft. It now waits for the enabled edit-mode Cancel button. A probe delaying only the store's mirror by 300 ms reproduces the CI signature on the parent. First CI sighting: https://github.com/GUYI-AI/gugu/actions/runs/41970754276

flakes.symptom: Case "preserves words typed during durable custody (failed / clear)": expected 'queued original' to be ''.
flakes.note: Playwright fill() on a contenteditable selects through the DOM and presses Delete; ProseMirror reads that selection only on the async selectionchange event, so under load Delete hit the caret and removed nothing. The test now selects through the editor's own keymap. 16 runs on 8 cores: parent 8/16 red, fix 32/32 green.

flakes.test: android-build: Gradle cannot start process 'command node'
flakes.symptom: "A problem occurred starting process 'command node'", followed by "does not specify compileSdk".
flakes.note: build.gradle ran "node" by bare name; Java resolves it through the PATH the reused Gradle daemon was started with, so a daemon started from a shell without node failed every build it served. android-gradle-build.sh now passes its own absolute node as -PguguNode and fails without one.
